userArtDirection: Thick angular near-black navy outlines; broad flat cel color masses; geometric construction; sparse interior lines; limited material tones; no rideable empty space.

prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ANIMOL Echo Theater rail-cart PRODUCTION sprite sheet, replacing the empty cart in input1.
Inputs: input1 is geometry/heading reference only; input2 is the game's established theater palette/style family. CHANGE the empty load area and simplify the rendering according to this art direction.
PRIMARY: a compact one-grid-cell theatrical PROP CART that is visibly NOT RIDEABLE. Completely fill its box with three chunky stage-prop masses: a square wooden prop crate, a tightly folded BURGUNDY curtain bundle, and a small cream/gold framed wooden scenery panel leaning inside the box. Cargo stays inside the cart width; no empty standing floor or seat can be seen. The load remains identical in all views and never disappears. Keep four dark flanged wheels, a gold diamond on the front panel, and a forward burgundy padded BUFFER that indicates heading.
ART DIRECTION IS MANDATORY: crisp THICK almost-black NAVY exterior outlines, thinner minimal interior lines; construct silhouettes from straight segments, wedges, trapezoids, near-right-angle turns, angular curves. Broad flat color masses, each material just base plus one polygonal shadow and at most a small solid highlight. Navy/violet shadows. Vivid burgundy accents balanced with warm walnut, pale cream and ochre gold. Flat 2D TV-cartoon/cel look inspired by Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt. No gradients, airbrushing, shiny metallic 3D rendering, tiny texture, painterly grain, diffuse glow, or glossy ball finials. Replace round corner finials with small faceted geometric caps. Substantial geometric wheels remain readable.
CAMERA: front-centered overhead square-grid view, ground horizontal and vertical axes stay screen aligned. No isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Opposite sides of the square cart bed have equal widths. Use vertical side edges, a shallow front face, cargo height rising UP the image rather than shrinking ground depth. Wheels and cargo fully visible; allow transparent room above load.
LAYOUT EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS, 8 isolated sprites. Row0: SOUTH, EAST, NORTH, WEST headings (buffer bottom/right/top/left respectively). Independently drawn under the SAME camera/light, never rotate the entire image. All have the SAME cart footprint, body scale, cargo and visual anchor.
Row1: exactly the same four sprites in same heading order, alignment and cargo, with ONLY the forward padded buffer slightly compressed on contact. Body and cargo do not squash, shift or change.
True transparent RGBA background with clear gutters, no rail/ground/platform/shadow. No people, passengers, faces, text, labels, arrows, lights, or extra sprites.

Use case: style-transfer.
Repaint THIS EXACT 8-cart sprite sheet into FLAT 2D ANGULAR TV-CARTOON art. Preserve the four headings, layout, cargo-filled bed, crate/curtain/scenery panel, bumpers and registration. No empty seat or standing floor.
The original image is ONLY a geometry reference. Its shiny rendering must be completely replaced.
TOP PRIORITY: VERY THICK CRISP NEAR-BLACK NAVY OUTER CONTOURS, angular corners, wedge cuts, polygonal silhouette. Outer strokes roughly 3 times the current thickness. Interior outlines thin and sparse.
EVERY colored region must be ABSOLUTELY FLAT SOLID COLOR. Only TWO tonal steps per material: a base fill and ONE solid navy/violet polygon shadow. A few cream/brass highlights may be solid flat wedges, never glints or reflections. No gradients anywhere.
Make the brass trim FLAT OCHRE with a flat CREAM EDGE, not shiny reflective metal. Replace ALL spherical gold finials with FACETED DIAMOND CAPS. Burgundy fabric is a simple folded geometric block with one polygon shadow, not rounded luminous upholstery. Wood uses two broad brown planes, not grain lines. Wheels are chunky angular dark navy octagons with flat ochre hubs. Cargo is bold, simplified and silhouette-readable.
Use the strong angular graphic language of Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt. This should read like a clean animation cel or vector-cutout game sprite, NEVER 3D-rendered toy art.
Keep ground axes square-screen aligned and body one-cell wide. Same 4x2 sheet arrangement, clear transparent gutters, genuine alpha background.
No new props, people, symbols, labels, text, motion effects, track or backdrop. Repaint all eight carts uniformly in the flat angular style.

sources.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Production sprites: repaint all SIX rail tiles in input1 in the exact flat angular graphic style of the FILLED CART in input2.
Preserve the 3 columns x2 rows atlas and connection order: top row horizontal EW, vertical NS, bend NE; bottom row bend ES, bend SW, bend WN.
MANDATORY linework: very thick crisp almost-black NAVY outer contours, simple angular wooden sleepers with clipped corners, thin sparse interior lines. Flat 2D TV-cartoon/cutout style. Each material has a flat base color and ONE flat polygon shadow. Ochre-gold rail with a SOLID cream edge stripe, dark walnut sleepers with a solid muted violet shadow, navy iron feet. NO gradient, wood grain, shiny metallic reflections, glow, airbrushed shadow, 3D render or backdrop.
ALL rails are a pair of clearly separated continuous parallel paths at the SAME gauge. Both rails must connect to the required cell-edge ports. FIX THE BOTTOM-RIGHT tile: it is a complete WEST-to-NORTH 90 degree bend, both rails enter from the LEFT and BOTH turn upward and reach the TOP. No short cut-off rail or dead end inside this curve.
Square-grid planar overhead view, +X screen right, +Y screen up; rails meet requested edge MIDPOINTS, no foreshortening or isometric tilt. Horizontal reaches left/right, vertical reaches top/bottom; bend endpoints tangent to the cell edges, no caps on open connectors.
Keep each of the six sprites separated and fully readable in its cell with alpha transparency outside the track. No cart, text, labels, arrows, lights, floor tiles, or extra branches. Genuine transparent RGBA background.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create FOUR TIGHT curved railway game tiles, 2 columns x2 rows, true transparent background. Each tile is a SQUARE GRID CELL and the bend fits one cell. This is a flat 2D TV-cartoon rail set matching the input's thick navy outline, flat ochre/cream rail strips, brown wood ties and polygonal violet shadows.
Each tile is a WIDE-GAUGE tight 90-degree bend: two nested rail paths with a SMALL inner bend and a LARGE outer bend. The gap between the two rails is HALF THE TILE WIDTH. Do NOT draw two close thin rails sweeping a huge radius.
Geometry guide for each 512x512 logical tile: rail gauge256, line thickness32. For NE, the two top rail endpoints are x128 and x384 at y0; the two right endpoints are y128 and y384 at x512. They form complete nested quarter-circles centered on the TOP-RIGHT cell corner, radii128 and384. Thus the CENTERLINE top port is TOP MIDPOINT, right port RIGHT MIDPOINT. Rail ends have no caps and do not stop early. Every rail reaches both of its requested cell edges.
Tile order: top-left NE (top and right), top-right ES (right and bottom), bottom-left SW (bottom and left), bottom-right WN (left and top). All four use the same wide gauge, line weight, wood tie thickness and camera. Ground axes are exactly screen horizontal/vertical. No perspective, no base.
All rails are CONTINUOUS paired paths, no short/broken rail or extra branch. Cross ties are large simple angular brown planks spanning the TWO rails radially around the turn, with clipped corners. Restrained brass caps; solid flat colors, ONE polygonal shadow only, no gradient/glow/texture/3D rendering.
This is a production 2x2 tile atlas. No cart, straight-track cells, arrows, text, labels, characters, floors, or other objects. Alpha transparency everywhere outside tracks.
sources.usedRegions: NE/ES/SW only; incomplete WN region excluded

sources.prompt:

Make a HORIZONTALLY MIRRORED version of this exact single railway bend. Preserve the flat colors, thickness, TWO complete rails, same gauge and tight radius. The new tile must connect the TOP to the LEFT instead of top to right: both rails reach the TOP, curve counterclockwise, and both rails reach the LEFT. This is a simple horizontal reflection of the complete input geometry, not a new design. Both paths must remain unbroken. Keep all sleepers. No additional track, no overlap, no crossing rail.
Same thick near-black navy contours, flat ochre/cream tracks, brown ties with one violet shadow; no gradient, no added glow, no text. Isolated single sprite on genuinely transparent RGBA background.
